newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural confirms free capital rise, share split.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural confirms free capital rise, share split.

text.p: Gas Natural confirmed on Tuesday that it will propose a free capital increase and a share split at its next shareholders meeting on June 18.
A spokesman for the company said: "The board decided on May 21 that it will propose to shareholders a four for one share split and a capital increase to be charged to reserves."
Shareholders funds will be raised to 74.63 billion pesetas from 22.39 billion pesetas, charged to reserves.
After the split the number of shares will rise to 149,258,670 from 37,314,669.
The move will divide the shares' face value by four from 600 pesetas each to 150 pesetas each, and then rise to 500 pesetas following the free capital increase.
"The aim of the operation is to increase the attractivenes of the shares," the spokesman said.
